title: Oakay
description: An 18+ community-driven SMP focused on long-term worldbuilding, player governance, and collaborative survival.
body:
# 🌿 Oakay Season 2 is Coming! 🌿
Mark your calendars! Season 2 officially launches on **May 2nd**. We're gearing up for a brand-new world, a totally fresh start, and new adventures for the community. Gather your friends and get ready for launch day!

![Oakay Server](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5S1JEMkU/images/571a13bb4924e5b36d8c811cd9bb3fd9463cfe52.png)

Oakay is a governed, community-first **18+ Minecraft server** dedicated to long-term worldbuilding, structured progression, and player-driven governance. Designed for mature players who value collaboration over chaos, Oakay offers a refined survival experience supported by active political structures, custom technical integrations, and a deeply rooted community culture.

## 🏛️ Player-Driven Governance
At the heart of Oakay is a formal political structure that empowers the community to shape the server's future and infrastructure. 
* **Elected Officials:** Participate in structured election cycles to vote for or run as the Mayor or a Minister.
* **Active Ministries:** Dedicated leaders—including the Minister of Commerce, Minister of Recreation, and Minister of Community & Outreach—actively manage specific server districts and community initiatives. 
* **Civil Campaigns:** We enforce fair, organized campaigning rules to ensure a positive, constructive, and highly engaging election season.

## 🌍 World & Legacy
Oakay thrives on organization, intentional design, and dedicated spaces for community interaction.
* **Long-Term Worldbuilding:** We value your time and creativity. Server resets are rare, occurring only every couple of years, allowing players to build massive, sprawling foundations and leave lasting legacies.
* **Player-Driven Lore & Advancements:** Leave your mark on the server's history. We feature bespoke, custom in-game advancements inspired by our players' actual achievements, inside jokes, and major server lore events.
* **Dedicated Districts:** Explore and contribute to specialized, minister-run zones like the bustling Shopping District, the structured Gaming Disctrict, and the welcoming Community District.
* **Community Events:** The server is brought to life through major, organized gatherings and spin-off series. Past highlights include our custom Skyblock and Last Life server events, competitive Gaming District tournaments, massive Ender Dragon fight events, interactive server tours, and lively election seasons.

## ⚙️ Server Features & Integrations
We utilize optimized setups and custom tools to maintain a seamless, fair, and highly organized environment.
* **Optimized Performance:** The server runs on carefully selected performance mods to ensure a smooth, lag-free experience, even as our world grows in complexity.
* **[Interactive BlueMap](https://map.oakay.ca/#oakay_survival:0:0:0:1500:0:0:0:0:perspective):** Explore Oakay directly from your browser. Our live, high-fidelity BlueMap allows you to track builds, scout terrain, and see community progress in real-time.
* **Custom Datapacks:** Advanced background systems, including automated AFK handling and dynamic team-management integrations, keep the server running smoothly without administrative clutter.
* **Discord Integration:** Our Discord is the official hub for announcements, elections, and server lore. Membership is required to maintain whitelist status, keeping the community connected and accountable.

---

### 🤝 Join the Oakay Community
Whether you are an ambitious builder, a redstone engineer, an aspiring server politician, or simply looking for a relaxed and welcoming place to call home, there is a place for you here!

To review our community guidelines and apply for whitelist access, join [our official Discord](https://discord.oakay.ca/)!
